purpose: Diffuse/albedo atlas for the approved local NPR farm art sample. This image is a texture asset, not an in-game screenshot.

generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production diffuse/albedo texture atlas for a pastoral 3D game, not a scene or concept illustration.
Create one landscape 3:2 image, ideally 1536 x 1024 pixels. Fill the entire image with exactly 3 equal-width columns and 2 equal-height rows, six square material swatches flush against one another with straight boundaries. No gutters, borders, text, labels or diagram markings.
TOP LEFT: warm grey-brown broadleaf tree bark, gently flowing vertical ridges, a few broad knots, subtle olive shadows, hand-painted low-frequency variation.
TOP CENTER: aged honey-brown timber planks, vertical grain and a few broad quiet seams, weathered and matte, no metallic fixtures.
TOP RIGHT: muted warm terracotta roof tiles in shallow repeating horizontal rows, simplified painted clay tonal variation.
BOTTOM LEFT: warm ivory lime plaster, very subtle pale peach and cool beige watercolor blooms, almost flat, gentle imperfections.
BOTTOM CENTER: natural restrained meadow-green painted ground surface, broad layered olive, sage and moss-green washes, very sparse soft grass accents, no distinct landscape objects.
BOTTOM RIGHT: restrained broadleaf foliage surface, connected soft irregular medium-green and pale sage brush masses, subtle blue-green shadow shapes, no distinct branches or sky.
Art direction: original Japanese pastoral animation background painting, hand-painted watercolor and opaque gouache character, sophisticated low-frequency brushwork, gentle natural middle values, readable surfaces when wrapped onto 3D meshes.
Technical constraints: flat front-facing material surfaces only, uniform diffuse illumination, no directional light baked in, no cast shadows, no perspective, no vignette, no gradients across the whole atlas, no photorealism, no high-frequency procedural noise, no shiny plastic, no excessive saturation. No characters, scenery, buildings, loose props, leaves silhouetted on transparency, logos, signatures, watermark, or text. Opaque image. Keep each material internally quiet and approximately tileable.
